changeSet.author: fund-transfer-gateway

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name = 'gateway_service'

changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS gateway_service;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON SCHEMA gateway_service TO "fund-transfer";
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA gateway_service GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLES TO "fund-transfer";
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA gateway_service GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON SEQUENCES TO "fund-transfer";
ALTER ROLE "fund-transfer" SET search_path TO gateway_service, public;
changeSet.rollback: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS gateway_service CASCADE;
